name: Blistering Gust
body:
School evocation; Level bloodrager 3, druid 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 60 ft..

Effect 60 ft. gust of scorching wind 5 ft. wide extending from your hand
Duration 1 round +1 round/level (concentration)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as gust of wind, creating a severe blast of air that originates from you, affecting all creatures in its path. Any creature in the area of effect takes 1d6 fire damage per two caster levels (to a maximum of 10d6 at caster level 20) and is fatigued by the rush of heat. A successful Fortitude save halves this damage and negates the fatigued condition. If you choose to maintain the effect a new save is required each round. This effect can cause a fatigued creature to become exhausted.
